article.title: The Global Energy and Emissions Footprint of AI Diffusion
article.author: Jesse Damiani
article.content: AI is a global megamachine devouring everything in its path. We can subject it to the same kind of lifecycle analysis used for other industries. The post The Global Energy and Emissions Footprint of AI Diffusion appeared first on MR Online .
